meaning.name: Declared model stubs at every authoring altitude

userStory.intent: I want to find products by entering keywords
userStory.outcome: so that I can quickly locate items I am interested in purchasing

experience.promise: The system will display a list of relevant products based on my search query.
observableConditions: A search input field is visible on the page.
After entering a query and submitting, a results page is displayed.
The results page shows a list of products matching the search query.
Each product in the list displays a name, image, and price.
If no products match the query, a 'no results found' message is shown.
The search results are displayed within an acceptable time frame.
